basic_info.description: Experience stunning views of the bay and ballpark from this contemporary 2BD/2BA residence at 88 King Street, South Beach's premier luxury high-rise. The custom kitchen features high-end stainless appliances and a dining area with fantastic vistas. Beautiful hardwood flooring flows throughout the living areas and bedrooms, complemented by a large walkout terrace and four oversized bay windows. Enjoy spacious, separated bedrooms, modern baths, and convenient in-unit laundry.    88 King Street offers a wealth of luxurious amenities, including a fitness center, pool, spa, sauna, business center, 24/7 concierge, valet parking, and space for one car. The location is unbeatable, with some of the best weather in the city, close to Oracle Park, Chase Center, The Embarcadero, parks, public transit, Caltrain, freeway access, and shuttle stops. This is urban living at its finest!
